title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure/Achievements and trophies
text:
There are 12 achievements for Xbox Live Arcade, and 12 trophies for PlayStation Network.

| 64px || Standing the Test of Time || Complete Story Mode or Challenge Mode for any character on any difficulty without using continues. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Stardust Crusaders || Win a fight with 22 different characters. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Patty Cake, Patty Cake || Activate a Blazing Fists match. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || The World is Your Oyster || Counter a time-freeze. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Never Saw it Coming || K.O. N'Dool via Perfect in bonus stage. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Mad With Power || Down an opponent with a Super Combo. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || This is Where You Fall Down || Down an opponent without using a Super Combo or Tandem Attack. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Crash and Burn || Down an opponent while they are Stand Crashed. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || The Kid Gloves are Off || Down an opponent while in child form. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Strong and Attractive || Raise Mahrahia's magnetic power to maximum level. || || 
|-
| 64px || Out of the Cage || Win one Ranked Match online. ||  || 
|-
| 64px || Show and Tell || Upload replay data. ||  || 
|}
